title: Theology Of Art
summary: Biblical foundation for creativity and the arts in worship.
content:
Creativity is not decoration — it is declaration.

Theology of Art and Creativity

God as Creator

Art exists because God is creative.From Genesis 1 onward, creation reveals design, order, and beauty that reflect His nature.

Creativity as Worship

When we paint, act, sing, or build sets, we echo the Creator.Our goal is not self-expression but God-expression — revealing His truth through beauty.

Biblical References

  • Exodus 31:1-5 - Bezalel filled with the Spirit to craft the tabernacle.
  • Psalm 33:3 - “Sing to Him a new song.”
  • Colossians 3:23 - “Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord.”

Application

Every creative act in ministry should:

  1. Glorify God
  2. Edify the Church
  3. Invite others into worship
